probeType.description: Type of probe used (tls-hello = handshake-only TLS liveness probe)

probeDuration.description: How frequently to probe in seconds

httpMethod.description: HTTP(S) health-monitor method (e.g. GET, HEAD). Optional/additive — empty defaults to GET. Control-plane only (probeReq/probeResp retained as the escape hatch).

urlPath.description: HM request path (e.g. /healthz). Optional/additive — empty falls back to probeReq or "/".

expectedCodes.description: Octavia expected_codes — single "200", list "200,202", or range "200-204". Optional/additive — empty defaults to "200".

httpVersion.description: HM HTTP version "1.0" or "1.1". When "1.1" a Host header is sent (domainName, else the member address). Optional/additive.

domainName.description: doubles as TLS SNI for HTTPS monitors AND the Host header. Optional/additive.
